We are growing the team to reduce single points of ownership, build deeper coverage across our platforms, and shift more of our work from manual support toward engineering, automation, and self-service. We're looking for a Cloud and Automation Engineer who thinks in systems, not just tools. You should be comfortable moving between cloud and on-premises environments, understand how infrastructure, identity, networking, and applications depend on one another, and be driven to replace repetitive manual work with code and process. You'll work as part of cross-functional squads alongside engineering, security, and business partners, so strong collaboration and communication matter as much as technical depth. This role is well suited to someone who has built real depth in systems and cloud engineering, who is genuinely energized by learning new platforms and approaches, and who wants to help mature a team's practices rather than just execute a backlog. This role is on a hybrid schedule, with office presence expected two days per week Responsibilities: Design, build, and operate infrastructure across Azure and on-premises hyperconverged environments, applying consistent engineering principles regardless of platform. Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks using infrastructure-as-code practices, reducing manual and repetitive work across the environment. Partner with cross-functional squads to translate business and application requirements into resilient, secure, and maintainable infrastructure designs. Co-design systems and platforms with application developers, favoring immutable infrastructure patterns so environments are consistently rebuilt from code rather than patched or drifted over time. Contribute to the evolution of our hybrid cloud strategy: helping decide what belongs in the private data center versus Azure, and building the automation that makes those workloads portable and consistently managed. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that span cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, and identity layers. Establish and document standards, patterns, and runbooks that reduce tribal knowledge and make systems easier for the team to support. Embed SRE principles and engineering practices into how systems are built and how the team works day to day, favoring measurable reliability, proactive detection, and repeatable process over reactive firefighting. Identify opportunities to insource work currently handled by external managed-service partners, and build the automation and monitoring needed to support it internally. Contribute to shifting the team's focus away from bespoke, hand-managed infrastructure and toward *aaS models and reusable, codified platforms, freeing capacity to focus on the systems that enable differentiated business capabilities. Participate in an on-call rotation and incident response, contributing to root-cause analysis and durable fixes rather than one-off remediation. Stay current with evolving cloud, virtualization, and automation practices, and bring new approaches back to the team. Requirements: Experience A solution-oriented systems engineering mindset, paired with continuous improvement and being easy to work with across teams. 5-10 years of demonstrated experience integrating and automating infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code approaches, in a public cloud (Azure preferred) and in a virtualized or hyperconverged on-premises environment. A track record of solving problems that cross multiple layers of the stack, not just working within a single platform or tool. Experience working in cross-functional or squad-based delivery models, partnering with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders outside your immediate team. Skills and Approach Demonstrated experience with Terraform and Ansible, ideally applied in an Azure environment. Strong grounding in core systems and cloud engineering principles: availability, scalability, security, cost, and operability, and the ability to reason about trade-offs between them. A builder's mindset: default to automating and codifying solutions rather than performing repeated manual work. A drive to optimize and re-engineer processes where it makes sense, rather than simply automating what's done today as-is. Comfort operating across a hybrid environment, understanding how workload placement decisions affect cost, performance, resiliency, and support burden. Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to work back from symptoms to root cause across interdependent systems. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and standards that other engineers can follow. A genuine appetite for learning: comfortable picking up new platforms, tools, and practices as the environment evolves, rather than anchoring to a fixed toolset. Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to simplify rather than automate around unnecessary complexity. A reuse- and security-first mindset, applied in a way that keeps sight of user and developer experience rather than adding friction for its own sake. Nice to Have Exposure to identity and access management, networking, or telephony systems in addition to core infrastructure. Experience contributing to architecture decisions or documentation (e.g., ADRs) rather than only implementing them. Familiarity with reducing reliance on outsourced managed services through internal automation and tooling. Experience working in a highly regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with the risk, compliance, and change-control expectations common there. Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. To succeed in this position you must be fully fluent in English (spoken and written). Please note that your resume must be submitted in English , and the interview process will be conducted in English.
